summary.text: Mary E. Howard, a Democrat from Rutland, has represented Rutland-6 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2017.
She is clerk of the House Committee on General and Housing and co-chair of the Vermont Worker's Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Howard has lived in Rutland County for more than forty years, according to her House biography.
She has worked for Central Vermont Public Service Corporation, Graybar Electric Company and, for more than a decade, the Rutland County State's Attorney Office.
She has served as a United Way volunteer on its Allocations Committee and as a team captain for the American Cancer Society's Relay for Life.
She is a board member of BROC and has two children.
